store.name: Club 10 Chicken
store.description:
Club 10 Chicken in Chinnakakani, Mangalagiri is a café for crispy fried chicken, burgers, pizza and momos, with shakes, mocktails and desserts.

**On the menu**
- Fried chicken by the piece (2, 5 or 10), Chicken Wings, Boneless Strips, Chicken Lollipops, Chicken and Paneer Popcorn and a Mixed Bucket
- Burgers, sandwiches and rolls: veg, paneer and chicken, with the Club 10 Special (Nashville) and Cheesy Tower burgers
- Pizza, pasta and salads: sweet corn, paneer, chicken, tandoori chicken and the Special Pizza (chicken, paneer and corn)
- Momos, fried or steamed, corn samosa, and fries plain, masala, tandoori, cheesy or loaded
- Bubble tea, milkshakes, mocktails and eggless desserts: Lava Cake, brownies, Lotus Biscoff and Kunafa
- Combos, from a meal combo to the Club 10 Family Combo

**Good to know**
- Open every day, 12:00 PM to 10:30 PM
- 75 dishes, from ₹15 to ₹899
- Popcorn in small, medium and large; fried chicken, wings, strips and lollipops by the piece
